name: Nürnberg
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Nürnberg, Germany, from the city center to Nuremberg Airport, spanning the Nuremberg Metropolitan Region (Fürth, Erlangen, Schwabach, and 19 other municipalities). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring all 23 modeled municipalities.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
